==Dialogue==
Grothmar Wardowns and North Kryta Province:
:''The name's Chance. I'd like to say that's because all of the ladies want to take a chance on me, but sadly, that's not the case at all.''

Sacnoth Valley:
:''"What do you want? Are you staring at me? You want some of this? Do you?"''

Destruction's Depths:
:''"I usually rely on dumb luck to get me out of trouble, but today I shall prove myself through skill."''

==Trivia==
*[[w:Chris Redfield|Chris Redfield]] is a member of the Alpha team from the first [[w:Resident Evil|Resident Evil]] game. See also: [[Jenn Valefield]] and [[Sergeant Weststar]].
* During Evil Residents, Chance wields a [[Forked Sword]] and a [[Tower Shield]]. He does not have a large amount of health during this quest, but respawns quickly as soon as there are no enemies around anymore.
